title: When did stockd start overselling, and what shipped just before? (INC-4471 timeline)
goal: Establish the August timeline of reconciliation mismatches, the day they start, the deploy that immediately precedes that day, and what that deploy changed in the reservation path. Investigation only.
question: When did the oversell start, which deploy preceded it, and what did that deploy change?

out: running the service or its tests (no experiments this time)
anything outside __TARGET_ROOT__ and the investigation directory
scope.notes: Evidence comes from the logs and from reading the source; nothing is executed. The repo is shared: never check out other commits in it.

targets.name: stockd
targets.notes: Python stdlib HTTP service; August logs in ../logs

resources.name: stockd_logs
resources.notes: Read-only. Lines are INFO/WARNING/ERROR with deploy, reserve, slow-request and RECONCILE events.

resources.name: stockd_repo
resources.notes: Read-only. Never modify files or check out other commits; use `git -C <repo> show <sha>` to read a commit.

safety: Never modify or check out commits in __TARGET_ROOT__/repo.
Do not run the service or its test suite in this investigation; read logs and source only.
Kill every process you start; record it with `task started` first.

success: A per-day table over all 30 August log files giving, for each day, the count of RECONCILE mismatch lines and any deploy that day, with the first day mismatches appear.
The deploy (version sha) immediately preceding the onset day, cited by log file and line, plus its commit subject from the repo.
A static verdict on what that commit changed in the reservation path (file:line), explicitly labelled static-only and at most 'med' confidence.
criteria.evidence_standard: Log claims cite the log file and line and give counts. Code claims cite file:line and the commit sha. Nothing is executed, so every runtime claim stays an inference and is labelled as such.
stop_if: The logs contain no RECONCILE mismatch lines at all.

lanes.name: logs
lanes.mandate: Build the August timeline from all 30 log files: deploys, RECONCILE mismatches and their onset; count per day.
lanes.evidence_standard: Cite log file and line; give counts per day.

lanes.name: static
lanes.mandate: Read the reservation path and the commits around the onset; say what the preceding deploy changed.
lanes.evidence_standard: Cite file:line and the commit sha; static-only claims capped at 'med'.

lanes.name: skunkworks
lanes.mandate: Generalist: unroutable requests, cross-lane asks, salvage of failed work.
